interfaceGapsNoted: The answer shorthand (answer.report/overrides) is defined for UNREPORTED_TRAINING; delta 4 says TRAINING_BETWEEN_BREAKS is answered "as the unreported-training question is answered" without saying whether the shorthand expands to its listed sessions. The corpus answers it with explicit per-session facts (R7D-F26, R7D-F28).

Session references to weeks before the current one after a proposal was adopted (late reports, between-break answers, late strength on an earlier break's first day) rely on the client resolving week/sport/day references against the plan in force; the interface does not state whether past weeks remain addressable there (R7D-F28, R7D-F30, R7D-F31).

Race-week composition (race touch, shakeout, other runs) is the coach's decision, so the author cannot force a race week that holds only the race touch, an optional shakeout and the race (items 11f and 11h); bulk each-facts by role were used so that absent sessions expand to nothing (R7D-F32, R7D-F33, R7D-F34).

When a FROM_LOG nextSetting row appears is not knowable in advance; own machine settings were written with loadsByPattern. loadsByPattern is per pattern, so two machine exercises of one pattern in a session (lat-pulldown and seated-cable-row) cannot receive different own settings; the corpus avoided PULL settings (R7D-F16, R7D-F17).

startedAt is used as an interruption field by deltas 3, 6 and 7 but is not in the RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE interruption field list of INTERFACE-1 section 6; the corpus uses it as the deltas describe (R7D-F29, R7D-F30, R7D-F31).

asPrescribed:true copies sets, reps and reserve; whether it also records a load in a known unit (needed for a strength week to count under delta 6) when the row is ESTABLISH is not stated; the whole-week-in-both-sports case uses an athlete with KNOWN loads (R7D-F29).
An execution fact has no reason field (why a race was missed or a run cut); such context exists only in step notes, assumed not to reach the coach.
Whether reports carried by an event that is asked (not applied) count against a long reporting silence is not stated; bulk reports were placed so that no unintended month-long silence arises.

The interface does not say whether a fact clocked after its decision is refused alone or makes the whole review HOLD, nor whether a schedule change sent directly in the last week is refused or applied; those expectations are JUDGED (R7D-F19, R7D-F04).
